steps.text: Each player: a Home board, 5 Dwarfs and 3 Stables; 2 Dwarfs in the Entry-level dwelling; one of each Overview card
Random Starting player; Food clockwise from them: 1, 1, 2, then 3 for everyone else
Basic boards for rounds 1-3 and 4-12 side by side; the third basic board on its {s} side to the left

byPlayers.7: the larger board (6-7 side) and the smaller board

steps.text: Shuffle the 7 Harvest markers facedown onto round spaces 6-12; Harvest events card beside the boards
Remove one green-leaf Harvest marker; shuffle the other 6 onto round spaces 6-12, leaving space 9 empty
Supply boards (Introductory or Full side) with the Furnishing tiles; spare Dwelling tiles in reserve
steps.note: 6-7 players: use the Full game side

steps.text: Action space cards facedown, stacked: stage 4 at the bottom, then stage 3, stage 2, the round 4 card (Wish for children), stage 1 on top
steps.note: 2 players: remove the Exploration card with the Level 4 expedition and cover round space 9 with a Dwarf card

steps.text: Landscape tiles sorted by type; building materials, animals and Weapon strength markers in piles
Round 1: reveal the top Action space card; the Starting player places the first Dwarf
